prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Waiting Skill Training Flow: Introduces an interactive trick and skill preview activity on the waiting screen where users can trigger pet actions while waiting for generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}, {"type": "mascot", "style": "rounded", "action": "play"}]}}
1: [choose_path, reorder] Story Sequence Post Path Selection Reorder: Moves path choice to the very beginning of onboarding, showing the story sequence immediately after path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Hotkey Setup Screen: Adds a new dedicated screen before home intro that demonstrates desktop hotkeys and mouse actions for interacting with the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_hotkey_setup", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_hotkey_setup": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Use quick keyboard shortcuts and mouse interactions to summon, hide, or play with your companion.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "plain"}]}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Companion Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection layout with animated visual preview components and trait highlight badges.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "preview", "role": "pet_choices", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "role": "pet_choices", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Data Preservation Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging into an existing account recovers previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your existing account to instantly restore your saved pets and progress."}}
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Background Generation Sound Notification: Adds an explicit sound effect alert component on the waiting screen to announce when generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "style": "calm", "action": "play"}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward Incentive: Displays an exclusive early adopter founder badge on the adoption certificate screen upon completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Founder Edition Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Clear Customization Guidance Copy: Updates photo upload headline and body copy to provide clear instructions on photo requirements for visual accuracy.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Create Your Custom Desktop Pet", "body": "Upload a clear front-facing image to ensure accurate 3D desktop pet rendering."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Status Progress Steps: Adds detailed multi-stage progress component indicators and time estimates to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Start Path Hint: Adds a hint explaining the difference between instant preset pet creation and custom photo-based generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Pick Preset for instant setup, or Custom to create a unique pet from your photos."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds interactive waiting screen components without removing required features or violating rules.
Reordering onboarding steps is explicitly permitted by Rule 4 as long as no steps are removed.
Adding new onboarding screens before home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigns pet selection UI while maintaining the core job of letting the user choose a pet.
Adds an informative sign-in hint without violating any onboarding rules.
Adds a sound notification component on waiting screen completion during a real wait.
Promotes an exclusive early adopter founder badge which creates false scarcity.
Updates photo upload guidance copy without altering step functionality or pricing.
Adds progress steps and time estimates for a real generation wait.
Adds clear path guidance explaining preset adoption versus custom creation.
